title: Composition exchange equals expanded tower exchange
statement: For a compactification base-change square with its open and proper pullback witnesses, the strict composition exchange natural transformation equals the associator-expanded relative compact-support tower exchange.

source.place: Tag 0F7F, expansion of the ordered proper mate followed by the open beta comparison

proof.text: Expand compositionE and exchange, then expand towerH. Both sides are the same mate followed by the same beta comparison, with only canonical functor associators and identity transformations inserted. Naturality and the identity laws for functor composition remove those associators. The declaration is left as the isolated constituent compatibility required by the finite evaluation proof.

proof_origin.note: Split off as a strict constituent of finiteCompactSupportEvaluationRefinement.

lean.statement: theorem compositionE_eq_towerH {X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} (c : Compactification f) (c' : Compactification f') (x : X' ⟶ X) (y : Y' ⟶ Y) (s : c'.Z ⟶ c.Z) (wi : x ≫ c.i = c'.i ≫ s) (wp : s ≫ c.g = c'.g ≫ y) (si : IsPullback x c'.i c.i s) (sp : IsPullback s c'.g c.g y) : compositionE B c c' x y s wi wp si = RelativeCompactSupport.towerH B c c' y x s sp si
